text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear no-position in opening and closing","quality":"stated position","description":"The essay explicitly takes a firm stance against driverless cars and returns to that stance at the end."},{"evidence":"\"They might be very good vehicles but i say that they are very dangerouse\"","quality":"argumentative focus","description":"It keeps the writing centered on supporting a claim about why the cars should not be used."},{"evidence":"\"what if it brakes or dose not function right\"","quality":"reasoned concern","description":"The essay gives a concrete safety worry rather than staying at a general opinion level."},{"evidence":"\"I dont wanna get hurt or die and i dont want anyone else to get hurt or die\"","quality":"use of article ideas","description":"It uses the article's safety concerns to connect the argument to possible harm for drivers and others."},{"evidence":"\"Not only do you watch the car but the car watrches you too\"","quality":"development of explanation","description":"The essay elaborates on a specific point from the source and explains why that idea feels unsettling."},{"evidence":"full short conclusion ending with \"we should not be using or driving these driverless vehicles\"","quality":"conclusion","description":"It ends with a direct wrap-up that restates the main argument clearly."}]}
